terms.gloss: a stool or bench, for sitting or mounting

phrases.latin: ad mēnsam pater et Theodōrus, hic quidem in scabellō, stābant
phrases.english: Dad and Theo stood at the table, Theo on a stool

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 125.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
